title: Create the D1 migration and prepared data access layer
acceptance_criteria: The migration creates devices, push_subscriptions, and reminder_schedules with foreign keys, one subscription per device, timestamps, revocation, and useful due-time indexing.
All user-controlled values use prepared D1 statements with bind(); plaintext bearer tokens and VAPID private keys are never persisted.
The data access layer exposes focused operations for device, subscription, and schedule reads/upserts/revocation without accepting exercise or routine data.
Migration and data-access tests cover constraints, upserts, cascade cleanup, and invalid values at the application boundary.
completion_summary: Added constrained D1 schema, prepared DI data access for devices/subscriptions/schedules, revocation cleanup, validation, due queries, and deterministic tests.
